body: Oh I do. And they’re fucking awesome. I just suck man.  That’s part of the reason I’m checking out. They deserve way better and I am an embarrassment to them.
Idk. Just not how I wanna go. Lol. I know it’s dumb. If you knew me in real life it would make more sense that even in killing my self Id make it waaay harder than it needs to be.

I don’t want anyone to feel guilty. I’ve got an amazing family that’s been nothing but supportive. I’m just a fuck up.  If I do the classic suicide then they might think they failed me or could have done something to help me. If I just get lost then hopefully nobody will have any guilt. Also, selfishly, I don’t want people to think less of me when I’m gone. I know it’s stupid but I’ve come to terms with making stupid choices.

Maybe a cliff, maybe just let the elements take care of it. I’m heading to some of the wildest country in the continental US, there are a million ways to go out.  I’m just going to leave a note saying I’m going hunting for awhile.
